{if:SF_19}{c_label}Charges:{/c} {c_resource}{SF_20}{/c}
{c_label}Charge Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Recharge Time}{/c} seconds
{else}{c_label}Cooldown:{/c_label} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
{/if}Step through the shadows of Hell to emerge at the target location, gaining {c_number}{SF_7}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} as well as {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|x%|]{/c} increased Movement Speed which decays over {c_number}[{SF_15}|1|]{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Nether Step's{/c} portals remain for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} seconds and can be re-entered to move back and forth.
{c_important}Nether Step{/c} now lets you run through the abyss while {c_important}{u}Immune{/u}{/c} for up to {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} seconds. Cast again to exit early.
{c_important}Nether Step{/c} brings all your {c_important}Abyss Summons{/c} with you through the shadows and extends their durations by {c_number}{SF_25}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Nether Step{/c} grants {c_number}[{SF_18}*100|%|]{/c} Damage Reduction that decays alongside its Movement Speed Bonus.
{c_important}Nether Step{/c} sucks enemies into its exit portal and swaps places with them.
{c_important}Nether Step's{/c} Movement Speed Bonus lasts {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%|]{/c} longer.
